_README: SOP 8.1 step 3: THIRTY real examples from the task class this tool will
actually handle, each with a known-correct answer.
They have to be yours. A baseline measured on another domain predicts
nothing about this one -- SOP 10.1 gives leave-one-domain-out R-squared
of -2.09, which is worse than no information. Questions invented to fill
the file would produce a confident number deciding whether months of work
WHERE TO GET THEM. Decisions you have already made and know the outcome
of. Analyses somebody later checked. Anything where the right answer was
established afterwards by something other than an opinion.
Copy this file to stage-zero-questions.json and replace the rows.
exact    the answer must match after case and punctuation are folded
numeric  compared as a number, within tolerance (absolute)
oneof    any entry in accept counts as correct
Nothing here is graded by a model. A model grading a model reintroduces
the correlated error the baseline exists to measure.
